description: Figure 7, captioned “Distribution of articles across media outlets,” is a pie chart that visually represents the proportional distribution of articles among various media outlets. The chart is divided into multiple colored slices, each labeled with the name of a media outlet and a numerical value indicating the count of articles attributed to that outlet. The outlets listed include The Daily Caller (8), The Huffington Post (7), NPR (6), Vox (6), The Guardian (5), BBC (4), RT (3), Daily Kos (3), National Review (3), Red State (3), Fox News (3), PoliticusUSA (3), Shareblue (3), Drudge Report (8), Breitbart (14), and Other (13). The slices are arranged in a circular format, with each segment’s size corresponding to the number of articles it represents, though the chart does not explicitly label the percentage or proportion for each slice. There is no legend or additional visual emphasis such as exploded slices; the chart relies on the color-coding and numerical labels within each segment to convey the distribution. The total number of slices is 15, including the “Other” category.
